description: Returns books for active maturities admitted by the current policy, with market metadata and the top 3 ask/bid levels. Unlisted and past maturities are excluded, even when requested with `ids`. If a maturity leaves the policy, its books are hidden immediately, including books with existing offers. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination; default sort is `id` ascending.

chain_ids.description: Chain ID filter (comma-separated). Currently accepts at most one chain id.

collateral_tokens.description: Collateral token filter (comma-separated, matches any collateral). Maximum 150 values.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

ids.description: Market ID filter as a single comma-separated query parameter. Returns books for matching currently listed markets. Maximum 20 IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max 20, default 10).

loan_tokens.description: Loan token address filter (comma-separated). Maximum 150 values.

maturities.description: Exact maturity timestamp filter in unix seconds (comma-separated). Maximum 150 values.

maturity_gte.description: Inclusive lower maturity bound in unix seconds.

maturity_lte.description: Inclusive upper maturity bound in unix seconds.

sort.description: Sort by comma-separated fields (`id`, `ask`, `bid`, `maturity`). Prefix a field with `-` for descending. Max 3 fields.

name: morpho_midnight_list_books

data.description: Books with market metadata and the top 3 ask/bid levels.

asks.description: Ask levels, sorted best first. List responses include up to the top 3 asks.

bids.description: Bid levels, sorted best first. List responses include up to the top 3 bids.

market_id.description: Market id (32-byte hex) this book belongs to.

midnight.description: Address of the Midnight contract that owns the market.

liquidation_cursor.description: Liquidation cursor for this collateral, scaled by 1e18. The protocol derives the maximum liquidation incentive factor from it.

lltv.description: Liquidation loan-to-value for this collateral, scaled by 1e18.

oracle.description: Oracle address used to price this collateral.

assets.description: Total maker-side assets at this tick, using onchain rounding per offer (buy books floor, sell books ceil).

units.description: Total executable units at this tick.

data.description: Books with market metadata and the top 3 ask/bid levels.
